thread:
maria: Heads-up — Cobalt's security questionnaire follow-up landed. They want: 1) proof of KMS envelope usage for tenant keys, 2) RBAC change logs for service accounts over the last 90 days, 3) audit log retention export sample, and 4) our vuln-triage runbook for a customer-facing incident.
jon: Ack. Do we have an existing export we can hand off or do we need to generate?
maria: We have exports but they need a sanitized sample with tenant IDs redacted and an HSM/KMS key provenance trace.
vivek: For envelope, we can show the key-wrap flow — we use envelope keys in KMS with per-tenant data keys. I can produce a diagram + minimal evidence.
kyle: For RBAC, easiest is to pull `iam.audit_logs` from the last 90 days and filter by principalType=SERVICE_ACCOUNT. I can run it and redact.
maria: Can you paste the quick command you'll run so I can confirm filters?
kyle: Sure — sample (GCP):
```
# export IAM admin audit logs for service accounts
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" OR protoPayload.methodName:"GrantRole"' \
  --freshness=90d --format=json > iam_sa_90d.json
```
ashley: If they want a chain of custody for the KMS keys we should attach key-rotation records + KMS access logs. For AWS KMS that's CloudTrail events; for GCP Cloud KMS it's Cloud Audit Logs.
maria: Good point. We'll need to correlate the key IDs with rotation events and owner principals. Vivek, can you map key IDs to rotation timestamps?
vivek: Yup. I'll pull rotation events and produce a CSV like `key_id,created_at,last_rotated_by,last_rotation_ts`. I'll redact customer-specific IDs into `cust-<redacted>` tokens.
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-1189: "Cobalt SQ evidence pack — KMS + RBAC + vuln-runbook" assigned to @maria, @kyle, @vivek. Due EOD Fri.
maria: For the vuln-triage runbook, they asked for our incident escalation matrix and a sample postmortem redaction template. I have the matrix but need the postmortem template trimmed for customer consumption.
jon: We should also include the mitigation timeline for a recent low-severity vuln we patched last month to show cadence. Do we have a sanitized timeline?
vivek: I can redact that one, timeline only: discovery -> triage -> patch -> deploy -> verification. Strip internal ticket IDs.
maria: RBAC change logs — kyle, can you include both the `before` and `after` bindings for any service-account role grants discovered? They want proof we didn't grant broad roles inadvertently.
kyle: I'll attach diffs. If binding is large we'll summarize and show examples.
ashley: Reminder: conform to their evidence checklist: PDF + CSVs + a README that maps each file back to the SQ question. Also sign with our S3 pre-signed URL and expiry (7 days).
maria: Good. Action items: Vivek (KMS rotation CSV + envelope diagram), Kyle (IAM audit exports + binding diffs), Jon (sanitized vuln timeline and postmortem template), Ashley (assemble README + upload + presigned link). I'll compile and do final review.
jon: ETA for my part is tomorrow morning.
vivek: I'll have the rotation CSV and diagram by EOD today.
kyle: Running exports now; should have raw JSON in ~2h. Will redact and post back here.
ashley: I'll prep the README and make the upload location — want me to use `s3://redwood-sec-evidence/cobalt-1758883333/`?
maria: Yes. Use that path. Put a short `manifest.md` mapping files to SQ sections.
sec-bot: Reminder: Policy requires we run PII redaction checklist before uploading. See https://internal.redwood/sec/redaction-checklist
maria: Thanks. One more ask from Cobalt during the call: they want an example of how we route requests to fallback models during infra failures (they're worried about data leakage in fallbacks). We should include the routing policy snippet and clarify that fallbacks use same tenant isolation and no cross-tenant cache sharing.
vivek: I'll include the `routing_policy.yaml` excerpt and note the isolation guarantees.
maria: Great. I'll consolidate and send final presigned link to their security contact after we complete redaction.
ashley: Noted, I'll start the upload once files are in `/tmp/evidence_redact` and run the checksum and manifest generation.
kyle: Uploaded preliminary redacted IAM JSON to `/tmp/evidence_redact/iam_sa_90d_redacted.json`. Sample lines: `{"timestamp":"2026-01-12T14:03:00Z","protoPayload":{"methodName":"SetIamPolicy","serviceAccount":"service-123@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com","bindings_before":[],"bindings_after":[{"role":"roles/storage.objectViewer","members":["serviceAccount:svc-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}]}}`
maria: Looks good. Keep everything in the temp folder until review. Once I sign off, Ashley upload and expire link.
jon: If Cobalt asks for live verification, we can offer a short joint call and show logs in read-only view.
maria: Agreed. I'll propose a 30-min follow-up. Thanks team.
sec-bot: SEC-1189 status updated -> In progress. Due 2026-02-06 17:00 UTC
